name: Maximilian Gruber
bio:
Maximilian's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the vibrant liveries adorning race cars. He spent hours sketching designs and experimenting with model paints, dreaming of one day contributing to the visual appeal of racing machines. After completing his vocational training in automotive painting, he sought an entry-level position within a racing team, eager to learn from experienced professionals.

As a developing paint shop specialist, Maximilian is meticulous and detail-oriented, striving for flawless finishes on every panel. He approaches his work with a blend of technical precision and artistic flair, always eager to experiment with new techniques and materials. While still honing his skills, Maximilian's ambition and perfectionist nature drive him to continuously improve and contribute to the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave on top
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always uses a magnifying glass for final paint inspection.
Insists on listening to classical music while working for concentration.
Meticulously cleans his spray gun after every use, regardless of how busy he is.
